question: From which scriptural source is the Śaiva akaḍama teaching remembered?
premises: The term akaḍama is described as Śaiva.
This akaḍama is said to be remembered.
The citation is attributed to the Yāmalīya.
inference: The Śaiva akaḍama is remembered on the authority of the Yāmalīya.
uncertainties: The precise technical meaning of akaḍama is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And the Śaiva akaḍama is remembered thus, according to the Yāmalīya.
